# Local offline test distribution

Original Nova Image Studio: https://github.com/tianjiangqiji/nova-image-studio . This local customization is maintained at https://github.com/hanjiyou/nova-video-studio (source baseline fdc40fcd081aeed1b4f24e49c2e63ff4fbcd6bf1, plus the T16 follow-up reviewable working diff). Preserve the root AGPL-3.0 license, source attribution and corresponding-source obligations when distributing any future version. This test package has no public release.

Electron 43.4.0 includes Chromium and Node. LICENSE.electron.txt and LICENSES.chromium.html accompany the installed executable. Production npm dependency notices remain in app.asar and app.asar.unpacked; see dependency-license-inventory.json. The inventory lists metadata and notice files; it is not a complete legal compliance audit.

The separate ffmpeg-static 5.3.0 binary is FFmpeg 6.1.1-essentials_build-www.gyan.dev, GPL-3.0-or-later. See FFmpeg-NOTICE.md and resources/licenses/FFmpeg-GPLv3.txt / FFmpeg-build.txt. Source-material downloads beside the local installer are partial; T16 evidence records URLs, revisions, sizes and hashes. Missing exact linked-library revisions and upstream build/patch/toolchain materials remain a public distribution gate. No URL alone fulfills the obligation.
